title: Fail closed for incomplete platform-qualified F# framework reference packs
outcome: Platform-qualified F# roots never claim exact semantic authority while only the base Microsoft.NETCore.App reference pack is present.
acceptance: A net8.0-windows F# root either materializes every required platform pack or fails closed before semantic checking.
The netstandard ProjectReference compatibility regression asserts the disclosed fail-closed outcome for a platform-qualified root.

completion.summary: Removed silent base-pack substitution for platform-qualified F# contexts.
